title: Understanding L0 Regularization
text: L0 regularization limits the number of non-zero parameters in the model. Think about how this constraint might affect the model's ability to fit the data.

title: Logistic Regression Basics
text: In logistic regression, the output is a probability that is transformed using the logistic function. This probability is then rounded to predict the class label. Consider how this rounding might affect classification.

title: Exploring the Logistic Function
text: The logistic function, or sigmoid function, is defined as $$\frac{1}{1+e^{\left(-z\right)}}$$. When $$z=0$$, the function outputs $$0.5$$. How might this relate to the given hint about sigma(0)?

title: Classifying Data Points
text: If the predicted probability is greater than $$0.5$$, the model predicts $$1$$. If it's less than $$0.5$$, it predicts $$0$$. What happens when the probability is exactly $$0.5$$?

title: Effect of L0 Regularization
text: With L0 regularization, only a certain number of parameters can be non-zero. How might this affect the model's ability to fit the training data perfectly?
